pairs.locus: Aquinas, Summa Theologiae I, q.34 a.1
pairs.question: Utrum Verbum in divinis sit nomen personale?
pairs.answer: Nomen Verbi in divinis, si proprie sumatur, est nomen personale, et nullo modo essentiale.
pairs.derivation: Question is the article-1 dubium (the 'ARTICULUS 1' scaffolding line stripped, capitalization normalized, '?' added). Answer drops the framing 'Respondeo dicendum quod' (narration of answering, like a speech tag) and takes the operative first sentence, ending at the first full stop before 'Ad cuius evidentiam, sciendum est...' which begins the supporting exposition.

pairs.locus: Aquinas, Summa Theologiae I, q.34 a.2
pairs.question: Utrum Verbum sit proprium nomen Filii?
pairs.answer: Verbum proprie dictum in divinis personaliter accipitur, et est proprium nomen personae Filii.
pairs.derivation: Question is the article-2 dubium ('ARTICULUS 2' scaffolding stripped, normalized, '?' added). Answer drops 'Respondeo dicendum quod' framing and takes the first sentence to the first full stop; what follows ('Significat enim quandam emanationem intellectus...') is the justifying argument, so it is cut.

pairs.locus: Aquinas, Summa Theologiae I, q.34 a.3
pairs.question: Utrum in nomine Verbi importetur respectus ad creaturam?
pairs.answer: In Verbo importatur respectus ad creaturam.
pairs.derivation: Question is the article-3 dubium ('ARTICULUS 3' scaffolding stripped, normalized, '?' added; the title gives 'creaturam', matching the question). Answer drops 'Respondeo dicendum quod' framing and is the complete answering sentence; what follows ('Deus enim, cognoscendo se...') is the explanatory proof and is cut.
